programs.title: Cross-market lead-lag research program
programs.objective: Determine whether pre-match cross-market dynamics contain stable, independent and economically useful information beyond contemporaneous bookmaker market state.
programs.current_frontier: Program closed after failed independent replication, completed seven-season regime audit, completed 2024/25 source/market anomaly audit, and duplicate detection on Issue #513. No genuinely independent zero-cost preregisterable follow-up remains without reformulating the rejected statistic or requiring new paid intraday data.
stop_rules: Do not weaken or reinterpret the frozen V1/V2 validation gates.
Do not create another cosmetic transform of a rejected alignment statistic unless it is independently preregistered and mechanistically distinct.
Do not use match outcomes that were reserved for an untouched evaluation before the gate is frozen.
Do not request paid timestamped/intraday data without fresh explicit user approval.
Mark PROGRAM_DONE when no genuinely independent zero-cost preregisterable follow-up remains.
programs.program_done_reason: The zero-cost evidence stack is exhausted: V1/V2 remain unsupported/NO_BET; temporal regime stability was already audited; the 2024/25 source/market explanation was not supported; the proposed next temporal-stability child #513 duplicated existing work. Remaining options are cosmetic transforms of the rejected signal or fresh timestamped intraday data, which requires explicit user approval.

programs.title: Kickoff and calendar context research program
programs.objective: Determine whether kickoff time, weekday, calendar slot or related pre-kickoff context contains stable incremental information beyond market baselines.
programs.current_frontier: The pooled kickoff/calendar OOS test is negative, the preregistered league-heterogeneity follow-up (#514) found no stable validation+OOT pairwise heterogeneity, and the independent outcome-free opening-to-closing market-movement mechanism (#523) also failed its OOT bootstrap gate. The pooled null remains binding and the zero-cost mechanistic frontier is exhausted.
stop_rules: Do not search arbitrary time cutoffs, weekdays or leagues after seeing results.
Any heterogeneity test must freeze the comparison rule before evaluating league-specific outcomes.
Do not treat a subgroup win as rescuing the rejected pooled hypothesis.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval.
Mark PROGRAM_DONE when remaining follow-ups would be threshold mining or restatements of the rejected pooled test.
programs.program_done_reason: Issue #523 tested the last genuinely independent zero-cost mechanism allowed by the program: Bet365 O/U 2.5 opening-to-closing repricing with a frozen temporal OOS design. Calendar features reduced MSE only microscopically in validation and OOT, while the OOT paired-bootstrap 95% CI crossed zero (-8.102e-06 to +3.630e-06). Together with the negative pooled outcome test (#428) and negative preregistered league heterogeneity (#514), remaining zero-cost follow-ups would be threshold/weekday/league mining, cosmetic temporal restatements, or require new paid/prospective data. The stop rule therefore requires PROGRAM_DONE.

programs.title: Cross-market corner direction research program
programs.objective: Determine whether the frozen cross-market match-shape gap contains stable, transferable information about pre-match corner-market direction or ranking beyond trivial UP skew.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #522 found an encouraging continuous same-sample rank association after frozen residualization, but binary direction remained below the always-UP baseline. The genuinely independent zero-cost cross-league transport in Issue #528 passed its outcome-free coverage gate (74/74 Bundesliga and Ligue 1 matches) but did not transfer after controlling for the mechanical opening component: residual Spearman was 0.0503, deterministic permutation p=0.4125, the two leave-one-league residual signs opposed each other, and binary accuracy 0.6818 remained below the 0.7273 always-UP baseline. The program therefore ends NO_BET with cross-league transfer unsupported.
stop_rules: Do not retune match_shape_gap, its sign, Ridge alpha, FAIR_CENTRE definition or thresholds on the already-opened 194 corner movements.
Do not exclude weak cohorts or leagues post-hoc and do not use closing/in-play information as pre-match features.
Do not collect new prospective matches inside Issue #522.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval.
Mark PROGRAM_DONE when independent zero-cost evidence is exhausted or fails to support future confirmation.
programs.program_done_reason: The program's final permitted independent zero-cost test failed. Issue #528 transported the frozen match-shape signal without retuning to Bundesliga and Ligue 1 and found that the apparent raw correlation was dominated by the mechanical opening-line component; residual association was negligible and non-significant, league-held-out signs were inconsistent, and classification did not beat trivial UP skew. Existing work already covers same-sample falsification (#522), cross-league FAIR_CENTRE holdout (#385), historical CORNERS10/xG/shots/deep/rest/travel/volatility families, and the six-signal screen. Further zero-cost children would retune the already-opened movements, threshold-mine, or restate the same signal; genuinely fresh prospective or paid data is outside current authority. The stop rule therefore requires PROGRAM_DONE.

programs.title: 1. Bookmaker price formation research program
programs.objective: Test whether football odds movement contains separable common-information, bookmaker-specific repricing and margin components, without claiming unobserved bet-flow causality.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #532 completed the frozen Bet365/Pinnacle opening-to-closing decomposition across EPL, La Liga and Serie A with NO_STABLE_BOOKMAKER_SPECIFIC_PRICE_COMPONENT. Bookmaker-specific variance was non-trivial and not explained by overround alone, but common movement did not pass the untouched-OOT stability gate and only one league improved. Issue #553 then attempted the independent Bundesliga/Ligue 1 cross-book transport, but correctly stopped before reading outcomes: none of BW, IW, WH or VC met the frozen >=90% paired opening+closing coverage requirement in both OOS seasons and both leagues, so the terminal result is BLOCKED_BY_SOURCE_GAP. No economic-value or production claim is supported.
stop_rules: Do not infer bettor flow, bookmaker liabilities or intent from observational odds alone.
Do not fabricate/interpolate missing 24h, 6h or 1h snapshots.
Do not select bookmakers, leagues or probability bands after reading OOT outcomes.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval.
Do not promote any resulting feature to production inside this program.
programs.program_done_reason: All permitted zero-cost independent classes are exhausted. Issue #532 completed price-component decomposition and temporal stability; Issue #553 completed source feasibility for cross-bookmaker transport and proved the available source cannot satisfy its preregistered third-book gate. The economic_value_if_statistically_supported class is unavailable because #532 did not establish stable statistical support and #553 could not pass its outcome-free source gate. Repeating Bet365/Pinnacle, lowering the frozen coverage threshold, choosing books or leagues after inspection, or reusing opened outcomes would be duplicate or post-hoc; broader exact opening/closing coverage requires new data, and paid data is prohibited without fresh explicit approval. The program closes research-only with no production or betting authorization.

programs.title: 2. De-vig method OOS research program
programs.objective: Determine whether Multiplicative, Additive, Power or Shin transforms bookmaker 1X2 odds into the most accurate and stable out-of-sample fair probabilities for Football AI.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #533 found NO_STABLE_DEVIG_WINNER on EPL/La Liga/Serie A. The frozen Power candidate then failed independent Bundesliga/Ligue 1 transport in Issue #540: point estimates improved for both books and both leagues, but validation did not improve and the untouched-test fixture-cluster 95% CI crossed zero (-0.00335 to +0.00134). No de-vig method is authorized for promotion.
stop_rules: Do not add post-hoc de-vig variants after OOT results are read.
Do not silently clip mathematically invalid probabilities; report coverage/failure explicitly.
Do not select a winner from OOT and reuse the same OOT as confirmation.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval.
Any winner is research-only and requires a separate untouched promotion study.
programs.program_done_reason: The preregistered method audit, paired temporal OOS comparison, bookmaker stability, calibration diagnostics and independent league transport are complete. Power failed both the original confirmation gate (#533) and the independent transport gate (#540). Additional zero-cost children would add post-hoc transforms, reuse opened OOT outcomes, or reselect a winner from the same evidence, all forbidden by the stop rules. A genuinely untouched future-season promotion study is not justified without a supported winner.

programs.title: 3. Favourite-longshot bias research program
programs.objective: Test whether favourite-longshot calibration and return distortions are stable in Football AI historical data and how they change from opening toward closing.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #534 found NO_STABLE_FAVOURITE_LONGSHOT_BIAS on EPL/La Liga/Serie A. The frozen independent Bundesliga/Ligue 1 transport in Issue #542 also failed: validation and untouched-test pooled slope CIs crossed zero, validation league signs were inconsistent, and the preregistered favourite/longshot region direction failed in validation. No calibration correction or betting rule is supported.
stop_rules: Do not change probability bins after seeing outcomes.
Do not cherry-pick leagues, bookmakers, seasons or outcome types to rescue a pooled null.
Do not fabricate/interpolate missing intraday snapshots.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval.
Do not fit and validate a probability correction on the same untouched OOT sample.
programs.program_done_reason: The program completed the frozen opening/closing temporal audit, bookmaker comparison, calibration/return diagnostics and independent cross-league replication. Neither #534 nor #542 cleared its preregistered stability gates. Further zero-cost children would change bins, cherry-pick leagues/books/seasons, or refit a correction on already-opened OOT outcomes, which the stop rules forbid. The program therefore ends research-only and NO_BET.

programs.title: 4. Bookmaker margin structure research program
programs.objective: Test whether bookmakers systematically differ in total 1X2 margin and in how that margin is allocated across favourites, draws and longshots on the same matches.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #535 established stable matched-fixture Bet365/Pinnacle 1X2 margin-allocation heterogeneity, including a separate draw-pricing report, opening/closing comparison, temporal validation/OOT stability and alternate-consensus sensitivity. Issue #548 then completed the independent same-fixture Asian Handicap transport: the source gate passed and the validation/OOT pooled signs agreed, but the untouched-test AH effect was -0.00227 with a 95% CI of [-0.00531, +0.00097], so NO_STABLE_CROSS_MARKET_MARGIN_STRUCTURE. The supported 1X2 result remains observational and market-specific; no betting edge or production change is supported.
stop_rules: Do not compare bookmakers on non-matched fixture populations and call it a bookmaker effect.
Do not choose bookmakers after reading outcome performance.
Do not make causal claims about demand elasticity or bookmaker intent from observational prices alone.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval.
Any weighting/calibration change is research-only and requires a separate untouched promotion study.
programs.program_done_reason: All permitted zero-cost independent classes are exhausted. Issue #535 already completed source feasibility, matched bookmaker comparison, draw-specific pricing, opening-versus-closing temporal stability and alternate-consensus checks. Issue #548 completed the remaining independent market-type comparison and failed its frozen untouched-test CI gate. Repeating the 1X2 result, subdividing the already-opened outcomes, changing bookmakers after outcome inspection or retuning the AH contract would not be independent; broader exact timestamp/bookmaker coverage would require new data outside the current zero-cost source. The program therefore closes research-only with the supported 1X2 structural result unchanged and no production or betting authorization.
